prompt: On a rooftop urban garden, long wooden planter boxes overflow with tomato vines, lettuce heads, and basil pots under a patio umbrella. String lights zigzag above a wrought-iron table flanked by a wooden bench and two lawn chairs. A watering can stands beside a coiled garden hose near a terracotta birdbath. A solar panel tilts toward the sun by a compost bin and a wheelbarrow loaded with soil. A pair of gardening gloves and a sun hat rest on a trellis draped in climbing roses. A seedling tray, trowel, spade, and rake lie on a potting bench beside a potted palm. A wooden garden shed displays seed packets on a shelf. There is no bicycle, no scooter, no plastic toy, no cigarette butt, and no metal ladder.
